summary: Reprints the CLI from scratch under Printing Press 4.24.0 — context-first client, binary-response envelope decode, native FTS5, store extraction, and an SSRF-guard base-URL override helper.
reason: The published CLI was generated on 4.8.0. Regenerating under 4.24.0 picks up the context-first client signature and the framework's native FTS5, lets the hand-built offline search shrink to a thin wrapper, and removes generator-era workarounds. The carried-forward Phase 3 / Phase 5 / review patches (catalogued in the sibling patch files) were re-applied on top of the 4.24.0 base; this entry records the framework-refresh delta itself.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; restored real tests plus a new mutation-verified TestDecodeMaybeBinaryEnvelope pass. Tier-1 peer review (code + test) resolved all Blocker/Major findings; polish scorecard A/92; live dogfood 88/88.
